## Important
- cli/main.py:17 — correctness — Read the exclude default from ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE — With `ARCHIVE_EXCLUDE=*.log` and no `--exclude`, your parser uses `[]` and includes matching files. This violates “must also take its default from an `ARCHIVE_<NAME>` environment variable” (.agents/skills/cli-flags/SKILL.md:11). — CI jobs cannot configure exclusions through the required environment interface and must change their invocation to obtain the intended archive.
